_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for stable facts across every AHM public surface.
_rules: Values here change only on a deliberate release, never from a nightly scan.
Anything that changes over time (scan counts, averages, rates, distributions) does NOT belong here - it belongs on /dashboard, rendered from the database.
Consuming repos get this file via scripts/sync_canonical.py. Do not hand-edit the copies.
scripts/check_consistency.py fails the build if a surface disagrees with this file.

product.name: Agent Health Monitor
product.tagline: Trust layer for the agent economy

endpoints._definition: Billable data endpoints a caller can hit today. Excludes PUT /ahs/route/policy (integrator policy management, not a data product) and the two free preview routes.
endpoints._source_of_truth: x402_routes in api.py; count verified against RouteConfig entries

list.summary: Quick risk score for pre-flight checks
Premium risk with Nansen labels and PnL

free_routes.summary: Preview retryable failure count and estimated savings
Preview risk level and recommended services

unlisted_paid_routes.reason: Integrator policy management, not a data product. Excluded from the public count.

batch._note: Two real tiers. Never state one without the other - an unqualified single number is wrong.
batch.statement: Up to 10 wallets per x402 call at $10.00 flat, or up to 25 per request with an API key at 1 credit per wallet.

grades._source_of_truth: _ahs_grade() in monitor.py - the function the live /ahs path executes
grades._warning: Six grades. Do not publish any other threshold table. A/B/C/D/E/F are quality bands, NOT routing decisions - see routing.

routing._warning: Routing bands are a payment-gating decision derived from the grade letter. They are NOT a grade table and must never be published with score ranges of their own.
routing._configurable: Integrators can override these per-policy via PUT /ahs/route/policy, including allowlist bypass and confidence overrides. The mapping below is the default only.

default_bands.meaning: Moderate risk, hold funds until confirmed

dimensions._warning: There are THREE dimensions, not four. D4 does not exist in the scoring code. AHM Verify is a separate product, not a dimension of the composite AHS.

3D._when: Opt-in. Caller supplies an agent_url, enabling infrastructure probing.

list.name: Wallet Hygiene
list.note: Dust, spam tokens, gas efficiency, failed tx rate, nonce gaps

list.name: Behavioural Patterns
list.note: Transaction diversity, retry storms, activity gaps, gas adaptation

list.name: Infrastructure Health
list.note: Live endpoint probing. Only enters the composite when an agent_url is supplied.

dimensions.statement: AHS is a composite of two dimensions by default - D1 Wallet Hygiene at 30% and D2 Behavioural Patterns at 70%. Supplying an agent URL enables D3 Infrastructure Health as an opt-in overlay, reweighting to 25/45/30.

verify._warning: Anthropic-only. The GPT-4o / Gemini / DeepSeek strings in prompts.py are persona instructions injected into Claude prompts to diversify reasoning style - they are NOT other vendors' models. Never describe this as multi-vendor or 'six-model'.
verify.description: A six-role adversarial panel built on Claude: four independent generators, an adversarial critic, and a synthesiser. Compares a declared job spec against the delivered output and returns an ALLOW / HOLD / REJECT verdict with a confidence score.

api_access_tiers._note: Distinct product from shield.tiers. Same words 'Starter' and 'Pro', different prices - always qualify which product is meant.

registries._source_of_truth: CRON_SETUP.md schedule and the source mapping in db.get_ecosystem_dashboard_stats
registries._note: Six source labels appear in the data. Five are scanned registries; 'API' is the catch-all for wallets scored via direct API calls.

other_sources.label: API
other_sources.source: Wallets scored via direct API calls

erc8210.role: Scoring architecture aligned with IRiskHook and IIndependenceSignal

nouns._decision: The schema's unit is a single Ethereum address (known_wallets.address is the primary key). One operator can control many addresses, so 'agents' over-claims. Use 'agent wallets' everywhere, including the dashboard card label.

dynamic_figures._rule: These are the ONLY home for changing figures. Never hard-code any of them into static copy - link to the dashboard instead.
forbidden_in_static_copy: external ecosystem totals (e.g. agents registered across protocols) unless cited to a named external source
dynamic_figures.approved_phrasing: the largest longitudinal dataset of agent health metrics in the ecosystem - see live figures on the dashboard
